subject.title: bug(cost): mid-session writes to bootstrap-injected files trigger cacheWrite spiral on long agentic sessions; bootstrap-cache.ts shipped for #43532 is content-equality, not session-freeze

question: Should OpenClaw make bootstrap context session-stable, add dynamic-file/cache-boundary configuration, or document live-refresh as the intended contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable behavior affects model-visible session context, config/API surface, and existing expectations for live workspace-file visibility.

options.title: Add opt-in session-stable bootstrap
options.body: Preserve live refresh as the default, add a session-stable prompt snapshot mode for cache-sensitive agents, keep file-tool reads live, and cover session rollover/compaction semantics in tests and docs.

options.title: Use dynamic-file config
options.body: Implement the cache-boundary file classification path tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/65438 so operators can move volatile files below the stable prefix without freezing all bootstrap files.

options.title: Document live-refresh as intended
options.body: Keep the current content-equality cache and update prompt-caching/model-selection docs to warn operators that volatile bootstrap files can trigger cacheWrite churn.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in session-stable bootstrap
recommendation.body: Preserve live refresh as the default, add a session-stable prompt snapshot mode for cache-sensitive agents, keep file-tool reads live, and cover session rollover/compaction semantics in tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to the original bootstrap snapshot cache and prior implementation decision, making him the best available owner for the cache-contract choice.
